disclosures.text: A device for slicing food products.
Food products can have a non-homogeneous structure.
Food products supplied by a supply device to a cutting device.
The cutting device is a slicer.
Food products cut into slices in the slicer are removed by a removal device.
The removal device is formed by one or more endless belts.
Devices are provided in the slicer, supply device, or removal device.
The devices self-clean the slicer, supply device, and/or removal device, and/or cutting device.
The removal device is formed by an endless belt.
Devices are provided in at least one of the slicer, supply device, and removal device.
The devices sterilize the slicer, supply device, and removal device.
A suction unit for sucking away cutting powder is provided in the production zone of the slicer.
A conveyor belt is an endless belt.
The conveyor belt removes food products cut into slices in a slicer.
Food products are transported in the upper portion of the conveyor belt.
A device for continuous cleaning of the conveyor belt is provided in the lower portion of the conveyor belt.
A method for slicing food products having a non-homogeneous structure.
Supplying food products to a slicer by a supply device.
Cutting food products into slices in the slicer.
Removing slices from the slicer by a removal device.
During production breaks and/or production, at least one of the involved devices and/or the slicer are cleaned by suction.
Cutting food into slices in the slicer.
Sterilizing at least one of the devices or slicer by steam, peroxide, or ozone lamps during production breaks or production.
A method for cleaning an endless conveyor belt downstream of a slicing device.
Cleaning a lower portion of the endless conveyor belt with cleaning liquid.
The endless conveyor belt passes through a cleaning liquid.
Excess cleaning liquid can be scraped off.
The endless conveyor belt is further cleaned with brushes.

A device for slicing food products with non-homogeneous structure, comprising a suction unit for sucking away cutting powder in the production zone of the slicer.
A conveyor belt as an endless belt, removing sliced food products, transporting food in its upper portion, and having a continuous cleaning device in its lower portion.

A method for slicing food products with non-homogeneous structure, comprising supplying food to a slicer, cutting it into slices, removing slices, and cleaning at least one device or the slicer by suction during production breaks and/or pro
Self-cleaning devices are operable during production breaks.
Self-cleaning devices are operable during production.
Self-cleaning devices are operable with a cleaning liquid.
Cleaning liquid is sprayed onto the area to be cleaned using spray balls.
Spray balls are at the end of lines for cleaning liquid.
Spray balls comprise a plurality of openings formed as nozzles.
Drain facilities for cleaning liquid are provided in at least one of the slicer, supply devices, or removal devices.
No drain facilities for cleaning liquid are provided at the slicer, supply devices, or removal devices.
Cleaning liquid is dischargeable via drain facilities at a floor.
Devices for drying, rinsing, and/or disinfection are provided in at least one of the slicer, supply devices, or removal devices.
Sterilizing devices are operable during production breaks.
Sterilizing devices are operable during production.
Steam, peroxide, or ozone lamps are used for sterilizing.
Cutting powder is sucked away during production.
The lower portion of the conveyor belt is cleaned with a cleaning liquid.
The lower portion of the conveyor belt is guidable through a cleaning liquid.
Devices for scraping off cleaning liquid are provided at the lower portion of the conveyor belt.
Devices for brushing the conveyor belt are provided at the lower portion of the conveyor belt.
